recent_changes.description: Phase 01: Enforced clinic_id filtering in get_patients_with_last_visit and scoped patient unique index to clinic_id.
Phase 02: Configured Vercel functions to region icn1 (Seoul) and deduplicated profiles queries via app_metadata.clinic_id.
Phase 03: Consolidated prescription trigger cascade into atomic create_prescription RPC with O(1) clinic_daily_stats rollup.
Phase 04: Consolidated 14-query statistics waterfall into get_dashboard_statistics_v2 RPC.
Phase 05: Eliminated 1,000 medicine client-side load; implemented debounced server search (< 20 items) with pg_trgm + unaccent.
Applied all 4 migrations to remote Supabase project rrpbwyiobezgesameexo using Supabase MCP.

decisions_made.decision: Scope patient uniqueness to (clinic_id, LOWER(name_normalized), dob)
decisions_made.reason: Allow distinct clinics to manage patients with identical names and birth dates.

decisions_made.decision: Prioritize app_metadata.clinic_id over profiles query in getAuthUser()
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates redundant database roundtrip on authenticated API calls.

decisions_made.decision: Consolidate prescription insertion and daily stats rollup in single atomic RPC
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates trigger storm and race conditions during high-concurrency prescribing.

decisions_made.decision: Combine pg_trgm and f_unaccent() for medicine search
decisions_made.reason: Provides fast, diacritic-insensitive search directly inside Postgres without client-side loops.
Guarantees out-of-order search responses are safely discarded.
